body: Found by the V1-0593 native lane Ginkgo follow-up (branch claude/cem10-native-ginkgo-0593, head 471823458, 2026-10-17). The new 'Ginkgo v2 live qualification' paragraph in docs/specs/test-runner-execution-v0.md records 10 actual corvint-test-runner witnesses (Ginkgo 2.33.0, Gomega 1.40.0; evidence /private/tmp/cem10-build/native-2026-10-17/), but the older Ginkgo v2 (experimental) section, its traceability row (around line 219), and internal/testrunner ginkgo-provenance.json still state runtime NOT_RUN; the new paragraph only says it supersedes them. Expected: one consistent statement of Ginkgo runtime evidence.
title: TRE spec Ginkgo v2 (experimental) section, its traceability row and ginkgo-provenance.json still say NOT_RUN after the 2026-10-17 live qualification
